notes: Answers are stored flat: profile[field.key] = value. Keys are unique within org and within project. repeater -> list of objects keyed by sub-field keys; geo -> {lat, lng}; file -> {name, docId?, url?} (upload via /api/ingest/file first); multiselect -> list of option values; toggle -> bool; currency/number -> number; date -> YYYY-MM-DD. usedByVoice=true fields are turned into project prime memory. validation keys: pattern, message, min, max, minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems, afterField.
